willow.why_harmful: Spreads along creeks, chokes stream beds and lowers water quality for native plants and animals.
willow.status: Weed of National Significance; declared pest plant in the ACT
willow.source: Weeds Australia (weeds.org.au/profiles/willows-except-weeping); ACT Pest Plants and Animals (Pest Plants) Declaration 2015 (No 1)

privet.why_harmful: Birds spread its berries into bushland, where it crowds out native plants and reduces food and habitat for native animals.
privet.status: Declared pest plant in the ACT
privet.source: NSW WeedWise (weeds.dpi.nsw.gov.au/Weed/Privetbroadleaf); ACT Pest Plants and Animals (Pest Plants) Declaration 2015 (No 1)
